description:
About the company
 Our client is a software company.
 The role
 Raydar is recruiting for this role on behalf of our client. Take a founding role in shaping a product's data layer, working closely with the technical lead on ingestion, record matching and warehouse design from the start.
 What you'll do
 - Design and build data ingestion pipelines and matching logic that turn customer records into structured, reportable data.
 - Architect a data warehouse so that customer data stays flexible, trustworthy and easy to report on.
 - Build tools that reconcile and integrate data across systems.
 - Work with the CTO to shape the core system of record.
 - Turn a largely manual customer onboarding process into a repeatable, automated product.
 Requirements 
 What we're looking for
 - Prior experience delivering a working data platform in Python and SQL, starting from a blank slate.
 - Skill in translating complex data topics for colleagues and customers without a technical background.
 - Hands-on work building extract-transform-load flows, covering data moves, duplicate removal and record matching.
 - Working knowledge of a relational database such as PostgreSQL and of a cloud analytics warehouse.
 - Comfort working in an early-stage company with a strong influence on product direction.
 Bonus points
 - Exposure to bringing AI model services into data workflows.
 - Comfort with business intelligence dashboarding tools and visual reporting.
 Benefits 
 Compensation and benefits
 - Base salary: USD 180,000 to 220,000 per year
 - Equity
 Location and work model
 - New York, New York, United States
 - Hybrid, 3 days per week in office
 - Full-time
